exposure: Timing of initial breastfeeding (within 24 hours, 24-48 hours, 48-72 hours, after 72 hours)
cohort: The study included 12,679 very preterm infants (<32 weeks' gestation) admitted to NICUs within 24 hours of birth and initially breastfed within 7 days.
finding: Early breastfeeding initiation (<24 hours) was associated with a higher incidence of necrotising enterocolitis but also linked to a shorter duration of intravenous nutrition in very preterm infants.
mod_finding: Increased NEC risk was observed in neonates delivered via caesarean section within subgroup analysis.
gest_age: <32 weeks' gestation (very preterm infants), with a subgroup analysis for <28 weeks' gestation
